intro: These draws have no preference or bonus points: every application has the same chance each year, so there's nothing to build up. Odds below are last year's tags divided by applicants.

draws.name: Florida statewide alligator hunt
draws.window: Phase I May 8-18, Phase II May 22-Jun 1, Phase III Jun 5-15, leftovers from Jun 18 (2026)
draws.cost: Free to apply; $271.50 resident / $1,021.50 nonresident if drawn (license, permit and 2 tags)
draws.how: Random drawing in phases. Pick up to 12 area and week choices; one permit per person through Phase III.

draws.name: Mississippi public-waters alligator
draws.cost: $2.39 to apply; permit fee not in the season report
draws.how: Computer random draw by zone (one zone per person); unsold permits go to a second draw of people who missed.

draws.name: Montana Upper Missouri paddlefish (Fort Peck Dam to Fort Benton)
draws.how: Random drawing, parties of up to 5. If you don't draw you get a catch-and-release license. The Yellowstone, lower Missouri and Dredge Cuts tags are sold over the counter.

draws.name: Louisiana recreational alligator (new in 2026)
draws.window: Not posted yet; season is October 1-31
draws.cost: $50 per zone to apply; $25 alligator sport license
draws.how: Lottery across 8 zones (A 500, B and C 1,250 each, D-H 400 each). Louisiana residents 16+ with hunter education; you can win more than one zone.

draws.name: Missouri managed waterfowl hunts
draws.tags_txt: Half of daily spots on 13 areas
draws.window: Pre-season Sept 1-18; in-season draws every week (Tuesday to Monday 3 p.m.)
draws.how: Random reservation draws, plus a morning "poor line" draw for the other half of spots.
